title: Developing modern drumming with Dizzy Gillespie
summary: After Edgar Hayes and Claude Hopkins he found Teddy Hill's band, where Dizzy understood his rhythmic ideas and he tried out written patterns with foot, left hand and cymbal.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
